TAN AI VIDEO LAB - dua len Cloudflare Pages
1. Vao dash.cloudflare.com > Workers & Pages > Create > Pages > Upload assets.
2. Dat ten du an (vd: tan-ai-video), keo tha file ZIP nay (hoac giai nen roi keo tha file index.html).
3. Bam Deploy. Mo link *.pages.dev la dung duoc ngay.
Gioi han: video duoi 1 phut va duoi 10 MB.
Khach tai video len, cat doan, chinh mau, doi toc do/am thanh, roi xuat ra MP4 / WEBM / GIF / WAV.
Video duoc xu ly ngay tren trinh duyet cua khach, khong gui len may chu. Nen dung Chrome hoac Edge tren may tinh de xuat MP4 nhanh nhat.
Duoc phat trien boi Tan AI.
